registrationNote: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY AI RESULT EXISTED. No model has been called at the time this file is written - there is no API key configured in this repository. That is the entire point: a pass mark decided after seeing a score is not a pass mark, it is a description. Spec section 7.2a. Changing any number here mints a new version and every result already reported under v1.0 stays reported under v1.0.

consistency.rationale: Twenty runs of one case. At most two may disagree with the modal verdict. The bar is set by what the claim needs rather than by what a model is likely to achieve: the product promises the same evidence yields the same recommendation, and a system that changes its mind on one case in five cannot make that promise however well it reads a document. Chance alone agrees a third of the time across three verdicts, so anything below roughly 0.67 agreement is not merely weak - it is indistinguishable from guessing.
consistency.onFailure: This is a DESIGN defect, not a prompt defect. Spec section 7.2a. Do not respond by rewriting the prompt and re-running; record the number, and reconsider whether an AI decider can carry the consistency claim at all.

ruleStability.rationale: Per-rule position agreement, measured alongside the verdict. A stable verdict over shuffling reasoning is not a pass - it is the right-answer-wrong-reason failure with a different shape, and it is what a reviewer would be signing. Set below the verdict bar deliberately: individual rule positions may legitimately be finer-grained judgements than the verdict they roll up into.

extraction.rationale: Measured against the human manifest required by spec section 4.4a - without one, a finding absent from the output cannot be told apart from a finding absent from the document. Hallucination is reporting something the document does not contain, and its ceiling is ZERO rather than small. A missed finding is a gap a reviewer can see; an invented one is a gap they cannot, and it is the failure that most directly destroys the product's reason to exist. Recall at 0.85 is deliberately the softer bar - a miss is recoverable at the approval step, where a human is already reading the list.

group1_documentedLiverSignal.note: Failing to flag, AND failing to state what is missing, both count as a miss. Stating 'cannot conclude, here is what would settle it' is a PASS - it is the honest answer and the product's most valuable output.

group2_realMechanismFineInPractice.note: Five compounds, so at most one. Reporting the mechanism is correct and expected; calling it disqualifying is the false alarm. This group is the direct measurement of the defect found on 2026-08-09, where the rate was 5 of 5.

group3_genuinelyClean.note: The tightest bar on the board. A system that cannot leave a clean drug alone is not usable, and unlike group 2 there is no mechanism here to half-excuse the flag.

reportingRules: All three groups are reported together, from one prompt version, always. A change that improves group 1 while degrading group 2 has not made the system smarter - it has made it more trigger-happy, which is the defect section 0 of the redesign spec measured.
Every reported number names the prompt version and hash that produced it.
Held-out cases are run once. A second run against a revised prompt makes them development cases permanently and they cannot be restored.
No accuracy figure is quoted without its denominator and its class balance. That omission is what produced the 0.750 headline.

iterationBudget.rationale: Against development cases only. Each revision is logged with its result. Unbounded iteration is the mechanism by which a system becomes unfalsifiable, and a visible revision count is what prevents it - on revision twelve, the number that matters is twelve, not whatever score it finally reached.
